## Purpose

Describe the accepted issue and user outcome.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests or deterministic checks are included.
- [ ] Observed facts, inferences, and unknowns are distinguished.
- [ ] No credentials, private transcripts, or user-specific absolute paths are included.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and limitations are documented.

## Risk

State whether this changes permissions, external contracts, storage migrations, security boundaries, or release behavior. Any such change requires escalation under `docs/REVIEW_POLICY.md`.
